column1: # Clear paths, one line per area of each map, measured by map_size.py (kept out of the repo) on 2026-11-05
# from <Diablo II>\ProjectD2's layouts (nothing measured in game). path: the length in tiles of a walk that
# brings 95% of the area's reachable spawn spots within 35 subtiles of the player along the ground (8
# directions, no corner cutting), from where the player comes in (start: the level's start tile, its
# waypoint or its warp tile, as the wiki's layout pictures mark the map start; see the tool): a greedy walk
# toward the nearest spot not yet seen, its stops then put in a shorter order (2-opt, Or-opt). The average
# of every layout file and of 7 walks per layout, one from the entrance and 6 from points 2-6 tiles
# from it (one walk alone varies by up to ~13%); an area of several walkable regions joined by portals (the
# Outer Void) one walk per region. "five starts": no known entrance, the average of walks from the corners
# of the walkable region and its middle. full: the same walks until every spot is seen. Most players clear
# 90-95% of a map (the author, 2026-10-28). tools/gen_map_exp.py divides the experience line by a map's path
